seo.title: Your fursona, organised into one link
seo.description: Reference sheets, exact color palettes, artist credits and commissions, all on one page. Pawfit: the fursona archive built for the furry community.

banned.title: This account has been suspended
banned.hint: Contact the site team if you have questions.

hero.title: Your fursona,{br}organised into {mark}.
hero.lead: Reference sheets, exact color palettes, artist credits and commissions, all on one page. Send it to artists, fursuit makers or friends instead of digging through chat logs for your refs.

collect.title: Everything in one place
collect.body: Multiple fursonas and multi-angle galleries, with 2D art, 3D models and real-life photos kept strictly separate. Commissions can go into a private collection too.

palette.title: Palettes that are exact
palette.body: Every color has a name, a body-part note and a hex code. Artists copy it in one click instead of color-picking from screenshots.

share.title: One-click share kit
share.body: Generate a share link that unfurls into a preview card on Discord or Twitter. Turn on watermarks or disable the link at any time.

notice.title: Adult content is supported from day one, but hidden by default.
notice.body: Every upload must be tagged SFW or NSFW. Viewers must complete age confirmation and choose how it is shown; guests never see NSFW content.
